name: Marrickville Mini Open AM 2022
information: #### Registration for this competition has closed and the waiting list is full. We are actively working on organising more competitions, check out the page of [upcoming competitions in New South Wales](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?utf8=%E2%9C%93&region=all&search=New+South+Wales&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) to find the most up-to-date list. This competition is a **series competition** alongside [Marrickville Mini Open PM 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleMiniOpenPM2022). You may only compete in one of the two Marickville Mini competitions. Note that the AM and PM competitions have slightly different events. We also have a [Big Cubes competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleBigCubesDay2022) taking place the day before this one - you CAN compete at that competition as well as this one. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)
